# Code of Conduct

Mira Terminal follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and patient, assume good intent, welcome people of every background and level of experience, and keep criticism about the work, never about the person. Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not tolerated, in issues, pull requests or anywhere else the project lives.

To report unacceptable behaviour, contact the maintainers privately through the repository's **Security** tab (**Report a vulnerability**) or by a direct message on GitHub. Every report is reviewed and kept confidential. Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, or ban contributors who break these rules.
